select.if: SELECT nvl((select org_name_local from org_master where organization_id = a.team_organization_origin_id),' ') as team ,nvl((select org_name_local from org_master where organization_id = a.section_code),' ') as section ,nvl((select org_name_local from org_master where organization_id = a.task_code),' ') as task ,nvl((select org_name_local from org_master where organization_id = a.part_group_code),' ') as part ,nvl((select org_name_local from org_master where organization_id = a.unit_code),' ') as unit ,a.employee_head_count as total ,a.lateness ,a.leaving_early ,a.outing ,a.training ,a.annual_leave FROM ( SELECT a.division_code ,a.department_code ,a.team_organization_origin_id ,a.section_code ,a.task_code ,a.part_group_code ,a.unit_code ,a.employee_head_count ,sum(a.tardy_count) as lateness ,sum(a.early_leave_days) as leaving_early ,sum(a.going_out_count) as outing ,sum(a.sel_training_complt_count) as training ,sum(a.use_annual_leave_days) as annual_leave FROM tb_att_daily_report_s a WHERE a.time_and_attendance_date between to_date(#{dateFrom},'DD/MM/YYYY') and to_date(#{dateTo},'DD/MM/YYYY') GROUP BY a.division_code ,a.department_code ,a.team_organization_origin_id ,a.section_code ,a.task_code ,a.part_group_code ,a.unit_code ,a.employee_head_count ) a order by a.unit_code asc, a.part_group_code asc, a.task_code asc, a.section_code asc
